finance: Quick note 14: were piloting two billing changes next month: a small credit rollover and a peak smoothing throttle (both opt-in for now).
support: Quick Q  how will customers enable rollover?
finance: Console -> Billing -> Credits -> Enable "Rollover pilot". Support can toggle until UI is live.
cal: Telemetry: will throttle events surface in headers/metrics?
finance: Yes  header `X-RW-Throttle: soft` and `X-RW-Throttle-Delay-ms`. Also emit `billing.rollover.active` in usage exports.
sam.f: Partners want invoice previews for overage + rollover estimates.
finance: New preview API: `GET /v1/billing/invoice_preview?account_id=...&as_of=...` returning CSV-friendly rows. OpenAPI to follow.
marta: Add alert when rollover hits cap so customers arent surprised.
finance: Agreed  add Console alert + changelog entry.
ops-bot: Pilot schedule: console flag rollout 2026-05-05 -> full by 2026-05-12. Enforcement for pilot cohort starts 2026-05-20T00:00:00Z.
billing-bot: Policy created: brl-2026-05-01-rollover-smoothing. Public comms planned at rollout.
support: Drafting emails and FAQ, will post links here.
finance: Thanks all  will share pilot account CSV with Support/AMs 2026-05-02. Ping me for spec early.
